name: Decorated Singleton-$aq$ Contraction Obstructions
definition: Take the crossed base with $U=\{u\}$, $\alpha=1$, and $\beta=0$. Delete $\{a,q\}$ and, according to $\rho,\sigma\in\{0,1\}$, optionally delete $\{a,b,q\}$ and $\{a,p,q\}$. Attach a new pendant coordinate above the remaining base, retaining the lone lower endpoint $R=\{b,p\}\cup V$.
parameters: $U=\{u\}$, $V$ arbitrary, and $\rho,\sigma\in\{0,1\}$. The pendant family has $2^d-2^{|V|+1}-5-\rho-\sigma$ states.
canonical_form: Exchanging the crossed wings gives the symmetric formulation with $V$ a singleton and the two corresponding optional states.
recognition: A construction certificate lists the deleted crossed wings and decoration, verifies the exact rooted-union hole sets at the complementary endpoints, and checks that their contraction-repair sets cover every base coordinate.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
